headline: AI/ML Engineer — Computer Vision, Real-Time Agents & Applied AI | Shipped at Scale
about:
I build AI systems that run in the real world — not notebooks.

Right now that means real-time computer vision for small, fast, hard-to-see objects (drones at 200 m), and agentic systems that stay under 500 ms end to end.

A few things I have actually shipped:

• Coordinate attention on YOLO11 for small-UAV detection — +4.2% mAP@0.5 and 15% fewer false positives on high-velocity targets. Lead-authored, Springer format.
• A spatiotemporal tracker for motorcycle safety compliance — +8.7% temporal accuracy at 45+ FPS, by rejecting single-frame errors with temporal consensus.
• Friday, an agentic voice assistant on LiveKit and the Gemini Live API: sub-500 ms turns, Mem0-backed memory, and MCP tools that actually run.
• shipfree, an open-source Agent Skill that teaches any AI coding agent to deploy an AI service on a free tier. Every limit it quotes is checked by CI against the platforms' own documentation, because a stale limit is worse than no limit.

• @TheIZGIV, an autonomous content agent that writes, edits and publishes to YouTube, Instagram and Facebook on its own.

I also spent a year on the plancks-constant-iitk simulation for IIT Kanpur's Virtual Labs — a browser-based circuit lab that ended up in front of 50,000+ students.

Currently a final-year Computer Science undergraduate in Kanpur, looking for a role where applied AI gets deployed and operated rather than prototyped. Open to remote and to visa sponsorship.

experience.title: Founder and Lead Engineer
highlights: Built and run a multi-node product ecosystem: an agentic voice assistant, self-hosted LLM inference hosting, a paid AI chat panel and a high-fidelity media streaming service.
Shipped @TheIZGIV, an autonomous content agent that publishes to YouTube, Instagram and Facebook without a human in the publishing loop.
Shipped shipfree, an open-source Agent Skill for deploying AI services on free tiers, whose limits are verified against upstream documentation by CI.
Run the whole stack on Docker and Cloudflare edge tooling, with a hardened CachyOS/Arch environment and no paid infrastructure in the serving path.

experience.title: AI/ML Developer and Project Lead
highlights: Engineered a low-latency voice and video agent on LiveKit and the Gemini 2.5 Flash Live API, holding end-to-end response latency under 500 ms.
Integrated persistent asynchronous memory with Mem0 to track preferences across sessions, cutting context lookup overhead by 30%.
Implemented dynamic tool execution over the Model Context Protocol, running n8n workflows and web search as agent tools.

experience.title: AI/ML Developer and Automation Engineer
highlights: Built an autonomous content agent that writes, edits and publishes to YouTube, Instagram and Facebook on its own. It runs the channel, not just the tooling.
Cross-platform video automation in Electron and Flask, cutting rendering and editing workflow time by 60%.
Audio-reactive editing with Librosa that synchronises visual transitions to the beat at 98% accuracy.
Integrated Edge-TTS voice generation with rate control and local looping fallbacks.

experience.title: Frontend and Simulation Developer
highlights: Built a physics simulation module for Planck's constant determination, deployed to a platform serving 50,000+ students across India.
Designed a browser-based wire-drawing connection engine for virtual lab components, keeping calculation lag under 10 ms client-side.
Automated real-time dataset plotting and constant calculation with Plotly.js in the browser.
